title: Concept: Credit score served in a response
description: A credit score or bureau rating value attached to a borrower record in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: A bureau score is licensed data with contractual handling limits, and in a page or API payload it can be scraped at scale to build a profile the bureau never authorised.
applicability: Bulk score exposure supports discrimination, targeted fraud and identity takeover planning.
risk: Credit data carries licence terms and privacy obligations that a cached payload cannot honour.
